reports.title: Corpay Reports Third Quarter Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2026 Outlook
section: “We are raising our full-year 2026 outlook to reflect our strong third quarter results and improved expectations for the fourth quarter,” said Peter Walker. “At the midpoint, our updated guidance calls for full-year revenue of $5.35 billion and adjusted net income per diluted share of $28.00, representing growth of 18% and 31%, respectively.”
For fiscal year 2026, Corpay, Inc.'s financial guidance1 is revised as follows:
•Total revenues between $5.340 billion and $5.360 billion, growing 18% at the midpoint year over year;
•Net income per diluted share between $20.03 and $20.23;
•Adjusted net income between $1.847 billion and $1.867 billion; and
•Adjusted net income per diluted share between $27.90 and $28.10, growing 31% at the midpoint year over year.
